instruction: Set the auto-recovery interval to 2 minutes in LibreOffice Impress options.

metadata.explanation: This task requires enabling auto-recovery feature in LibreOffice Impress and setting the auto-save interval to 2 minutes. The evaluator checks the registrymodifications.xcu file for both the AutoSave enabled setting and the AutoSaveTimeIntervall value. Similar complexity to the original task - both involve navigating to Tools > Options and modifying auto-save settings.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator correctly verifies both requirements: (1) auto-recovery enabled AND (2) 2-minute interval set
Metric function correctly handles expected parameter when type='rule' - directly accesses rules['minutes'] without incorrect nested access
XML parsing logic correctly navigates to /org.openoffice.Office.Common/Save/Document path and extracts both AutoSave and AutoSaveTimeIntervall properties
Data flow is correct: get_vm_file extracts the right config file, metric parses it and checks the right settings
Robust error handling for XML parse errors, file not found, and missing settings
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Minor: Consider adding logging to indicate which specific check failed (AutoSave disabled vs wrong interval) for better debugging
